baseline.observed: Measured 2026-09-15 on a detached checkout of origin/main with no local changes: 5 failed, 3619 passed, 25 skipped.
baseline.what_exists:
The five failures, with the cause of each:

1. tests/test_worker_brief.py::test_po_role_brief_section_3_has_pre_dispatch_checklist
   Asserts literal phrases in roles/PO.md section 3. PR #359 rewrote section 3
   as a transcript of the loop and moved the checklist. Three guarantees
   survived and are still assertable against section 3s `Before dispatching`
   list: `own scope`, `once, locally`, `lane is unused`.
   Three did NOT survive and must not be silently dropped:
     - `test tree has been searched` before a deletion-shaped movement
     - `commit early and often` as an instruction the packet gives the worker
     - the warning that a low default budget will not fit a CONTRACT, AUDIT or
       DEPLOYMENT movement
   roles/PO.md is governance: the worker must NOT edit it. Update the test to
   assert what the merged file guarantees, and record the three lost
   guarantees in the tests own docstring as an open Product Owner decision.

2 and 3. tests/test_gov_orch_9_backlog_split.py (two tests)
   These pin project/backlog.json against a fixture captured at the moment of
   the GOV.ORCH.9 split, row for row and payload for payload. The backlog is a
   living file that scripts/project_queue.py writes on every status change and
   new item, so both can only pass at the instant of the split. Measured: 43
   rows had legitimately changed and nothing was lost. The permanent invariant
   is that no id disappears from the union of backlog.json and
   project/archive/backlog_terminal.json, and that no id appears in both.
   Re-scope to that. Do not restore a content-equality assertion.

4. tests/test_cold_start_budget.py::test_cold_start_word_count_ceilings
   Measured: AGENTS.md 3479 words against a 3404 ceiling; AI_HANDOVER.md 1220
   against 300.
   AGENTS.md: PR #359 added the `## Host action boundary` section, measured at
   exactly 124 words (3355 before, 3479 after). The ceiling tables own comment
   records the precedent -- GOV.ORCH.7 raised it `by exactly the words added,
   per the movements own instruction`. Raise it the same way, to 3528, with a
   comment naming PR #359. Do NOT edit AGENTS.md.
   AI_HANDOVER.md: this is not a deliberate addition, it is the handover
   economy rule being broken. AGENTS.md requires a snapshot of at most six
   lines plus bullets. Rewrite it to fit under 300 words while keeping its
   required sections: snapshot, what changed, exact next action, test delta,
   new risks.

5. tests/test_successor_index.py::test_committed_index_matches_fresh_render
   PR #359 added docs/design/HOST_REGISTER.md and never re-rendered the index.
   `python3 scripts/successor_index.py` writes it; the diff is two lines.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Every failure is diagnosed and its remedy named. Bounded, no new design.

requirements: A ceiling is raised by exactly the words a deliberate section added, and the comment says which change added them. A round number chosen for comfort is a defect.
Every assertion removed must be replaced by one that holds a real, current guarantee, or be named in the docstring as an open decision.
risks: The easy way to pass four of these is to delete assertions. That converts a red suite into a suite that guards nothing, which is worse than red.

Any change under ui2/. A separate movement is live on those files.
